description.value: Guu Toramasa is a Japanese izakaya restaurant in downtown Vancouver themed around Osaka street food culture, managed by two staff members originally from Osaka. It is part of the Guu Izakaya chain, credited as the pioneer of the izakaya dining concept in Canada, blending traditional Japanese pub fare with the lively, communal atmosphere Osaka is famous for. Touring cyclists will find a full-service sit-down restaurant in the heart of the city, a short distance from the seawall and major cycling corridors.
